svg.title: CRUD lists: query, previous data and latest response
svg.desc: Editing filters alone does not query; submit with Search/Enter. Paging and sorting use committed filters. Only the latest response can update the controller. Initial failure shows retry; refresh failure retains old data by default. Empty state requires loaded and total=0.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
